choices.label: Set out firefly lanterns
choices.description: Soft lights make the flowers glow.

closing_lines.speaker: Mara
closing_lines.text: The garden feels like part of our days again—not a task we finished, but a place we can keep tending together.

closing_lines.speaker: Pip
closing_lines.text: And the old assembly makes color instead of numbers. I want to see what else these patterns can teach our tools.

closing_lines.speaker: Elowen
closing_lines.text: Travelers mention wind-marked stones beyond the north ridge. We needn't hurry. When we're curious, there will be another path.
